movie.storyTitle: สามก๊กบ้านเฮา EP01 — สาบานสวนท้อแบบคนบ้านๆ
movie.storySummary: เล่าปี่ขายรองเท้าสานไม่ออก เตียวหุยสายเมาชวนไปกินเหล้า กวนอูบังเอิญเข้าร่วมวง ทั้งสามคุยเรื่องบ้านเมืองแบบจริงจังปนฮา ก่อนสาบานเป็นพี่น้องใต้ต้นท้อ แล้วจบด้วยมุกว่าไม่มีใครมีเงินจ่ายค่าเหล้า
movie.mainStoryPrompt: Create a 36-second vertical historical comedy using Liu Bei, Guan Yu and Zhang Fei. Reimagine them with ordinary Isan Thai-looking faces and rough practical clothing, not polished idols. Visual tone resembles a faded 1970s Thai-Chinese historical comedy film. Use short Thai dialogue, clear speaker assignment, no overlapping speech, natural pauses and dry situational comedy. No modern objects.
movie.genreDetailPrompt: Retro 1970s historical comedy with actual Three Kingdoms characters, Isan-inspired ordinary faces, worn costumes, earthy village atmosphere and punchy Thai dialogue.

scenes.imageDescription: Vertical 1970s-style historical comedy still. Liu Bei as an ordinary Isan-looking middle-aged man, tired face, lean build, faded indigo-brown robe, worn sash, sitting at a tiny ancient market stall with handmade straw sandals and woven mats. Dusty rural late-Han-inspired village, practical rough set, faded color film, grain and soft focus. He looks sincere but broke, not handsome or glamorous.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium vertical shot, mostly static like an old 1970s film. Liu Bei waits at his poor sandal stall, watches customers ignore him, lifts one straw sandal and sighs. Only Liu Bei speaks in Thai: "บ้านเมืองก็วุ่น...รองเท้าข้าก็บ่มีคนซื้อ". Natural comic pause. No overlapping speech.

scenes.title: เตียวหุยสายเมา

scenes.imageDescription: Zhang Fei as a rough Isan-looking middle-aged man with thick beard, sun-darkened skin, stocky build, messy tied hair, worn lamellar pieces, old cloth wraps and woven sash accents. He carries a clay wine jar beside poor Liu Bei. Vintage 1970s faded historical comedy look.
scenes.videoPrompt: Zhang Fei barges into frame with a clay wine jar, slightly unsteady but energetic, slaps Liu Bei on the shoulder and says in Thai: "ขายบ่ได้กะพัก! ไปกินเหล้ากับข้า!". Liu Bei reacts silently. One speaker only.

scenes.imageDescription: Guan Yu reimagined as a rugged Isan-looking tall man, long untrimmed beard, stern tired face, faded dark-green robe with worn armor pieces and dusty boots. He looks directly at Zhang Fei's clay wine jar. 1970s historical film texture.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium two-shot. Guan Yu walks past, notices the wine jar, stops, gives a deadpan look and says in Thai: "เรื่องบ้านเมืองค่อยคุย...เหล้าอยู่ไส". Zhang Fei remains silent and reacts. Dry comic timing.

scenes.imageDescription: Simple peach garden with rough wooden table, cheap clay cups and rustic food. Liu Bei speaks sincerely; Zhang Fei eats greedily; Guan Yu listens sternly. Ordinary weathered faces and worn clothing. Faded 1970s Eastmancolor historical comedy aesthetic.

scenes.imageDescription: Grounded peach-garden oath scene, three rough ordinary-looking Three Kingdoms men raising cheap clay cups. No polished heroic pose and no fantasy effects. Vintage 1970s faded film, grain and worn costume texture.

scenes.imageDescription: At the peach garden exit, the three sworn brothers freeze awkwardly while checking empty cloth pouches. Ordinary rough faces, faded robes and worn gear. Comic embarrassment instead of heroic departure. 1970s film freeze-frame feeling.
